meta.scope: Iran Batch 10 — Nuclear power, EAEU trade framework, and youth labour densification.

candidates.title: Nuclear power generation statistics (Bushehr)
candidates.publisher: Derived from IAEA PRIS and national energy sources
candidates.description: Operational statistics for Iran’s nuclear power capacity, centred on the Bushehr-1 reactor (VVER, ~915 MWe net). Nuclear remains a small but strategically significant share of the power mix.
referenced_by: Energy balance and Bushehr provincial analysis
candidates.notes: Nuclear densification of the power cluster. Distinct from the broader nuclear programme.

candidates.title: Iran–Eurasian Economic Union free trade framework
candidates.description: Free trade agreement and cooperation framework between Iran and the Eurasian Economic Union. Provides preferential access and institutional linkage that complements the Russia partnership and BRICS membership.
candidates.notes: Regional preferential-trade densification of the external architecture.

candidates.title: Youth unemployment and youth labour-force statistics
candidates.description: Youth (15–24) unemployment and labour-force participation statistics. Youth unemployment remains structurally elevated relative to overall rates and is a persistent social and economic pressure point.
candidates.notes: Youth densification of the labour cluster.

candidates.title: Iran nuclear–EAEU–youth densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from energy, trade and labour sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding nuclear power generation (Bushehr), Iran–EAEU free trade framework, and youth unemployment/labour statistics into a coherent energy–external–labour residual layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
